title: Written on Our Hearts
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who keeps quiet truths tucked inside her, and tonight Heavenly Father promises to write His law on hearts so that doing right comes from the inside, the way Wren fishes the puzzle piece out from under the couch when nobody is watching.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because she keeps quiet truths tucked inside her, right where this promise goes. In Wren’s world today: nobody is watching when she knocks a puzzle piece under the couch. She could walk away. Instead, she lies flat on her tummy, fishes it out, and puts it back. Just like Heavenly Father writing His law on hearts, Wren learned that the best way to do right is from the inside.
